title: Course Writer and Editor UX UI and AI
description:
You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed thatÂ you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it. You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand.

Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world.

A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe.

Youâll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help usÂ take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Writers and Editors:Â lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

Weâre a flexible team, and youâll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Writer and Editor, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. OurÂ Education DesignersÂ hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders toÂ create educational content for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills inÂ timeless, human-centered design and AI.

  • Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.Â The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.

  • You don't need a design background.Â Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

  • Write for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

  • Be the voice of IxDF.Â Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours.Â Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

  • Turn expert material into lessons.Â Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

  • Our coursesÂ combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, givingÂ constructive feedbackÂ on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia.Â We're always learning, always improving, always raising the barÂ in everything we do.

  • Weâre committed toâ¯excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

  • Maintain and improve ourÂ crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll developÂ personally and professionally.

  • We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?

People don't just buy our courses; they invest in a better version of themselves and a career they truly love. That's why every course we create and every sentence we write must do more than just inform. It must reflect the high-quality research and hands-on skills we teach.

  • Show the dream outcome: Help people imagine a future of creative, meaningful work, fulfillment, and impact through a career in design and AI.

  • Strengthen belief in success: Build confidence through real stories, practical case studies, and hands-on templates.

  • Overcome barriers: Write in a way that's crystal clear, human, and motivating. Connect and lead the way.

You'll educate, inspire, energize, and support. Whether you write a course article or give editorial feedback on a video, you'll help designers thrive in the age of AI.

About You

  • You have at least 4 years of professional writing or editing experience.

  • What matters far more than the number is the quality of the work you can show us: a course, an article series, a set of scripts, documentation, a newsletter. Weâre excited to hear what it was, why you wrote it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

  • You're aÂ master communicatorÂ with aÂ sharp eye for detailÂ andÂ strong skills in language, tone, and flow.

  • You can take a complex idea and write it so a beginner gets it on the first read.

  • You know how to hook someone with a title and a first line, and you know the difference betweenÂ a hook that's earnedÂ and a hook that's cheap.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to write, research, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, soÂ the outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • Youâre eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You can write for a career changer and for an experienced designer without losing either one.

  • You have anÂ exceptional talent for creating structure, and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about UX and UI design, and you're motivated to learn how great design shapes experiences and solves problems.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathyÂ to engage well with very different kinds of people.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy.

  • You takeÂ full ownershipÂ of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You work well with great responsibility and freedom inside a well-documented, structured system. Accuracy and attention to detail are key on an online learning platform, where every tag must be correct and every piece of text formatted to our upload system. It's in your nature to meticulously double-check that everything is in order.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ taught in classrooms or workshops, orÂ you've created educational material.

  • You have yourÂ own blog or social media pageÂ where you create and share original content.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

  • You've writtenÂ quiz or assessment questions.

  • You've worked with anÂ LMS or an online learning platform.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in communications, journalism, literature, or a similar field.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role:Â You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impactÂ that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. Your words will be read year after year, by hundreds of thousands of people who build better careers and design a better world for all of us.Â An education you can't buy:Â free access to every IxDF course and Master Class, and a job that requires you to study the work of the best designers alive in order to edit it. Most people pay for this. You'll be paid for it.

  • Access:Â the designers whose books you'd normally buy are the people whose words you'll be shaping, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with.

  • Studio shoots:Â once you know our courses well, usually after your first year, you'll be a real asset on a studio production, and you'll be welcome to join us when we meet our experts in professional studios around the world. Some of us love that part and go every time; others keep travel to a minimum. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Autonomy:Â Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses read.

  • A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, orÂ corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

  • If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, youâre in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then youâll find virtuallyÂ limitless opportunities with us.

  • We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll helpÂ set a direction that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.Â

title: Lead Estimator
description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills

As market leaders and experts in luxury furniture design, we take pride in our commitment to quality and innovation.

For over 60 years, Nick Scali has been a nationally recognized household name in the Australian furniture industry. Following our acquisition of Plush Sofas in late 2021, we now operate over 110 showrooms across Australia and New Zealand, with exciting plans for further expansion in 2025.

Join an iconic Australian retail organization and be part of an international ASX-listed company that values career development in a supportive team environment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary with generous uncapped commission.
  • Continuous training and career development opportunities.
  • A supportive team environment that values innovation and improvement.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and dynamic Retail Store Manager for our Midland Showroom to lead, coach, and inspire the sales team to achieve individual and team sales targets.

In this role, you will create a positive and motivating environment while ensuring operational excellence in your showroom.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the showroom sales team, fostering a culture of positivity and collaboration.
  • Drive sales performance by utilizing your expertise in customer service and product knowledge.
  • Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and adherence to company policies and procedures.
  • Collaborate with the Regional Sales Manager to develop and implement strategies that maximize sales and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain showroom standards, ensuring compliance with visual merchandising and safety regulations.

Qualifications

  • Previous sales experience, ideally selling furniture or high-value items such as jewellery, cars, bedding, luxury goods / travel, etc.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a positive attitude and a growth mindset.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools

  • Wir suchen keine weiteren „Berater“, die uns höflich bestätigen, was wir schon wissen. description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Working Student – Go-to-Market Engineering (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

As part of the Revenue team, you will help design and implement systems that enable our sales team to operate more efficiently and scale outreach in a structured way. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to build automations, outbound workflows, and data pipelines that power our go-to-market strategy. You will be expected to work autonomously, think creatively, and find innovative solutions to process and system challenges.

Your Responsibilities

  • Sales Automation & Outreach: Build and optimize outreach sequences and messaging workflows for the Sales team, support the development of scalable outbound systems for account-based sales, and test and improve cold email performance and targeting logic. Think creatively to find new ways to reach prospects and improve conversion.

  • Revenue Operations & Systems: Maintain and optimize our CRM workflows in HubSpot, build automations and integrations between GTM tools using Zapier, support lead routing, enrichment, and pipeline automation, and propose innovative solutions to improve workflow efficiency.

  • GTM Data & Automation: Build data enrichment and prospecting workflows using Clay, help structure and maintain prospect and account data, and create scalable prospecting pipelines and enrichment processes. Work independently to develop new automation approaches.

  • Outbound Infrastructure: Support the setup and maintenance of outbound infrastructure with tools like Smartlead, assist with domain setup, deliverability monitoring, and campaign tracking, and bring creative ideas to optimize campaigns and sequences.

  • Process & Analytics: Analyze outreach and pipeline performance, identify bottlenecks in the sales funnel and propose automation improvements, and document and improve GTM processes.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Currently enrolled at a university (Business, Engineering, Data, or a similar field)

  • Strong interest in Revenue Operations, Sales Automation, or Growth Systems

  • Analytical mindset and curiosity for how systems and workflows work

  • Creative, solution-oriented, and autonomous approach to problem-solving

  • Structured way of working and ability to take ownership of projects

  • Good written and spoken English

  • Ideally, hands-on experience with tools such as HubSpot, Clay, Zapier, or Smartlead

  • Interest in Sales Tech, RevOps, or GTM Engineering is a strong plus

  • Basic understanding of outbound sales or B2B SaaS sales processes is beneficial

  • Experience with data tools, APIs, or no-code automation platforms is a bonus

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

title: Product Manager, eCommerce Solutions (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.

As a Product Manager for our eCommerce Solutions team, you will contribute to improving an Online Booking Engine (our core white-label product) that our partners use to allow their users to search, book, and manage their ground transportation tickets.

What you will do:

Timely and High-Quality Delivery of Roadmap: Ensure the successful and timely delivery of the product roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. This includes:

  • Achieve on-time delivery of planned iterations and releases, meeting or exceeding project milestones.

  • Maintain a backlog of well-defined and prioritized user stories that align with customer needs and business goals.

  • Minimize scope changes and rework through effective communication and requirement validation.

Stakeholder Alignment: Establish strong communication channels with stakeholders and ensure a shared understanding of product vision, progress, and timelines. This includes:

  • Build and maintain trust-based relationships with stakeholders by providing clear, structured, and consistent communication.

  • Proactively address stakeholder concerns and manage expectations to ensure alignment with the product roadmap.

Data-informed decisions: Drive continuous improvement of the product through data analysis, user feedback, and iterative development cycles. This includes:

  • Monitor and analyze key product and team KPIs (e.g., conversion rates, user engagement) to identify opportunities for enhancement.

  • Utilize data insights to prioritize features and improvements that have the highest impact on user satisfaction and business goals.

  • Implement iterative development practices, adjusting priorities and features based on real-time feedback and changing market conditions.

Workplace:

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • At least 3+ years of professional experience as a Product Owner

  • Have user-centric thinking: Ability to empathize with users, understand their needs, and prioritize features based on their value and impact

  • Strong communicator: You possess verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey the product vision, requirements, and updates to both the development team and stakeholders

  • Know Agile Methodology: You are proficient in Agile methodologies (particularly Scrum) to manage iterative development, prioritize work, and respond to changing requirements.

  • Hands-on with user story writing: You are able to break down complex features into clear and concise user stories that capture user needs, acceptance criteria, and business value.

  • Technically savvy: You understand the technical aspects of the product domain, allowing effective translation of requirements into actionable tasks for the development team.

  • Data-driven decision mindset: Your skills in using data and analytics help you make informed decisions, monitor KPIs, and identify areas for product improvement.

  • Problem-Solving approach: You are able to identify and address challenges that arise during product development, find creative solutions, and make timely adjustments.

  • Adaptability: You are willing to embrace change and adapt to evolving user needs, market trends, and business priorities

As a plus:

  • Experience with B2C products is a plus.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry

  • You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company

  • We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.

  • You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!

  • We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company

title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
description:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.
  • A hands-on, business-minded approach. You connect business questions with practical data solutions.
  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus.
Nice to have 
  • Experience with Metabase, dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, Airbyte, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.


What you can expect from us

How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.
 
Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 

  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint.

title: Projektmanager:in Operations und Partnerprojekte (all genders)
description:
Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.

MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.

Wir bauen gerade an mehreren Dingen gleichzeitig: einem neuen Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Piloten mit großen Marken, neuen Strecken, Integrationen. An jedem dieser Themen arbeiten mehrere Menschen aus mehreren Bereichen, und keiner von ihnen hat den vollen Überblick über alle anderen.

Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du weißt zu jeder Zeit, wo jedes Projekt steht, was als Nächstes ansteht und wo es gerade klemmt. Eine Frage zum aktuellen Sprint, und du kannst sie beantworten. Eine Frage zu einem Partnerprojekt, und du gehst auf die Leute zu und sorgst dafür, dass am Tag X alles steht.

Du bist kein Product Owner und musst nicht entwickeln können. Du musst verstehen, worum es geht, grob einschätzen können, was etwas bedeutet, und Dinge über die Ziellinie bringen.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Hamburg 🚀

Aufgaben

  • Überblick über alle Projekte

Du führst die Timeline über Marktplatz, unser Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Integrationen und Partnerprojekte. Status, nächster Meilenstein, offene Entscheidungen, Risiken. Alles an einem Ort, aktuell, und für jeden im Team in zwei Minuten auffindbar.

  • Themen aktiv vorantreiben

Du wartest nicht auf Statusmeldungen, du holst sie dir. Freundlich und hartnäckig, bis erledigt wirklich erledigt heißt.

  • Abhängigkeiten und Termine

Du erkennst früh, wo sich Themen gegenseitig blockieren, über Tech, Marketing, Operations und externe Partner hinweg. Und du eskalierst konkret: nicht "das wird knapp", sondern "wenn X bis Freitag nicht steht, verschiebt sich Y um zwei Wochen".

  • Launches und Piloten

Du planst und begleitest den Start neuer Produkte, Features und Partnerprojekte. Wer liefert was bis wann, was muss am Tag X stehen, was lernen wir danach. Und du baust Checklisten, die beim zweiten Mal besser funktionieren als beim ersten.

  • Schnittstelle zu Tech

Wir sind ein technisches Produkt, deshalb hängt vieles an unserem CTO. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen ihm und den laufenden Projekten. Du verstehst genug vom Thema, um in einem Kunden- oder Partnergespräch grob einzuschätzen, was etwas bedeutet, und um die richtige Rückfrage zu stellen.

  • Ziele und Rhythmus

Du hältst den Takt: Zyklen, Check-ins, Reviews, sichtbarer Fortschritt. Die Ziele setzen die Gründer:innen und die Verantwortlichen. Dass sie nachgehalten werden, liegt bei dir.

  • Meetings und Entscheidungen

Für deine projektübergreifenden Runden bereitest du vor und nach: Agenda, Unterlagen, Ergebnisse, To-dos mit Verantwortlichem und Datum. Entscheidungen dokumentierst du so, dass sie zwei Wochen später nicht neu verhandelt werden.

  • Externe Partner

Agenturen, Pilotpartner, Dienstleister. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit: Lieferungen, Termine, Feedbackschleifen.

  • Prozesse und KI

Wiederkehrendes standardisierst du mit Vorlagen und Checklisten. Du arbeitest KI-first: Statusberichte, Protokolle, Recherche und Dokumentation baust du mit KI. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, gerne in einem Startup, einer Agentur oder einem digitalen Produktumfeld. Du hast schon einmal ein Projekt mit mehreren Beteiligten und einem harten Termin über die Ziellinie gebracht, ohne selbst die fachliche Arbeit gemacht zu haben.

Du bist nah dran an digitalen Produkten. Tiefe Technikkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, aber du musst Sachzusammenhänge verstehen und grob einschätzen können, was ein Wunsch bedeutet, bevor du ihn zusagst.

Was uns genauso wichtig ist wie Organisation:

  • Du machst dir kritische Gedanken. Was verstehen unsere Nutzer nicht? Was macht der Markt besser als wir? Was könnten wir mit kleinen Impulsen schärfer machen?
  • Du fragst nach, auch dreimal, auch wenn es unangenehm wird.
  • Du hast Mut. Du sagst es, wenn du etwas für falsch hältst, auch wenn drei Gründer:innen im Raum sitzen.
  • Du lieferst zum zugesagten Datum oder verhandelst vorher neu, nicht hinterher.
  • Du wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand dir sagt, was zu tun ist.

Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch.

Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Benefits

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründer:innen: kein HR-Filter, keine Hierarchie dazwischen
  • Du siehst alles: Marktplatz, Produkt, Partner, Zahlen. Bei uns gibt es keine Ebene, die für dich zu ist.
  • KI-first im Alltag: wir arbeiten mit modernen Tools und zeigen dir, wie

Seit über 40 Jahren beraten wir Privatkundinnen und Privatkunden sowie Firmenkunden im Bereich Finanzen und Versicherungen. Wir stellen die Träume und Pläne unserer Kundinnen und Kunden in den Mittelpunkt und erarbeiten gemeinsam einen persönlichen Finanzplan; abgestimmt auf alle Facetten des Lebens. Bei HORBACH Berlin verbinden wir diese etablierte Marktpräsenz mit der Freiheit und Energie eines modernen Hauptstadt-Standorts.

Aufgaben

Schreibe deine Erfolgsgeschichte mit uns! Lerne im Rahmen des Praktikums alle Einstiegswege für deine erfolgreiche Karriere bei HORBACH kennen. Du gewinnst tiefe Einblicke in die moderne Finanzberatung – von der Neukundengewinnung bis zur Erstellung individueller Finanzstrategien:

  • Projektarbeit: Du realisierst eigenständig Projekte mit festen, klaren Zielsetzungen.
  • Netzwerk & Hochschulen: Du intensivierst gemeinsam mit uns die Zusammenarbeit mit Hochschulen und baust neue Kooperationen sowie Netzwerke in Berlin auf.
  • Event-Support: Du unterstützt aktiv bei der Planung, Organisation und Durchführung unserer Events und Karriere-Seminare.
  • Praxis-Insights: Du erlebst das Finanzunternehmertum hautnah und nimmst eine aktive Rolle in unserem Berliner Team ein.

Qualifikation

  • Interesse: Du interessierst dich für Finanzthemen und suchst einen geeigneten, praxisnahen Zugangsweg in diese Branche.
  • Mindset: Du bist zielstrebig, arbeitest selbstständig und packst die Dinge gerne aktiv an.
  • Kommunikation: Du bist kommunikationsstark, trittst authentisch auf und arbeitest gut und gerne mit anderen Menschen zusammen.
  • Zuverlässigkeit: Eine motivierte, zuverlässige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich aus.
  • Entwicklungswille: Du bist bereit, dich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, und offen für eine langfristige Karriere bei unseren selbstständigen Finanzberaterinnen und Finanzberatern.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir

  • Vergütung: Ein bezahltes Praktikum, bei dem du viel über dich, deine Fähigkeiten und deine persönlichen Stärken erfährst.
  • Theorie & Praxis: Wertvolle Einblicke in die Arbeitspraxis, die du beispielsweise perfekt für deine anstehende Abschlussarbeit nutzen kannst.
  • Flexibilität: Ein flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell, flache Hierarchien und eine Kultur auf Augenhöhe.
  • Weiterbildung: Exklusive Seminarangebote zur Selbstreflexion und zu deiner persönlichen sowie fachlichen Weiterentwicklung.
  • High-Level Kontakte: Du knüpfst neue, wertvolle Kontakte in hoch angesehenen akademischen und geschäftlichen Netzwerken.
  • Team-Spirit: Ein motiviertes und dynamisches Team im Herzen Berlins, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt.
  • Zukunftsperspektive: Die echte Chance auf eine langfristige Karriere im modernen Finanzunternehmertum (z. B. als anschließende Werkstudententätigkeit oder als Trainee).

Du willst in der Finanzberatung durchstarten?
Dann bewirb dich bei uns ganz einfach digital und ohne aufwendiges Anschreiben. Ein kurzes Profil oder dein LinkedIn-Link reicht völlig aus. Wir sind gespannt, dich kennenzulernen, und kontaktieren dich zeitnah!

title: Head of IT
description:
Was wir suchen

Die #1 Plattform für Neukunden

Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Head of IT (m/w/d) für unser IT Team, zu 100 % aus dem Home-Office (Deutschland) oder bei uns im Bremer Office!

Das sind deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst unser Tech-Team (aktuell 8 Personen aus Entwicklung, Daten und Infrastruktur) disziplinarisch und fachlich – inklusive 1:1s, Zielvereinbarungen, Weiterentwicklung und Recruiting neuer Teammitglieder.

  • Du übernimmst das operative Tagesgeschäft des CTO: Priorisierung, Ressourcenplanung, Eskalationen und alle Entscheidungen, die heute noch an ihm hängen bleiben.

  • Du verantwortest die Umsetzung unserer Roadmap über alle vier Bereiche hinweg – Product, Daten, Software und Infrastruktur – und sorgst dafür, dass zugesagte Termine gehalten werden.

  • Du sorgst für planbare Lieferfähigkeit: Du etablierst klare Prozesse für Planung, Entwicklung, Testing und Release und machst den Fortschritt für alle Bereiche im Unternehmen sichtbar.

  • Du baust eine belastbare Datenbasis auf: Du bringst unsere Kennzahlen zu Leads, Terminen und Aufträgen in eine Form, der Sales, Marketing und Geschäftsführung vertrauen können.

  • Du verantwortest Stabilität, Security und Skalierbarkeit unserer Plattform – von Monitoring und Incident-Management über Backups und Zugriffsrechte bis zu DSGVO-Themen.

  • Du bleibst technisch nah dran: Du bewertest Architekturentscheidungen, liest Code-Reviews mit und kannst im Zweifel selbst in den Code schauen – auch wenn du nicht mehr die Mehrheit deiner Zeit dort verbringst.

  • Du steuerst technische Schulden aktiv: Du machst sie sichtbar, bewertest sie wirtschaftlich und verhandelst mit den Fachbereichen, wann wir sie abbauen.

  • Du bist der Ansprechpartner der Fachbereiche für alle technischen Themen und übersetzt zwischen Business-Anforderung und technischer Umsetzung.

  • Du steuerst externe Dienstleister und Tools, inklusive Auswahl, Verträgen und Budgetverantwortung für den IT-Bereich.

Dank deiner Expertise erreichst du folgende Meilensteine bei uns

  • 0-3 Monate:

    • Du kennst Team, Systemlandschaft, Roadmap und die wichtigsten Stakeholder und hast mit jedem Teammitglied ein 1:1 geführt
    • Du hast eine schriftliche Bestandsaufnahme erstellt: größte Risiken in Stabilität und Security, größte Engpässe in der Lieferfähigkeit, Zustand unserer Datenbasis
    • Du hast die 1:1s, die operative Priorisierung und die täglichen Eskalationen vollständig vom CTO übernommen
    • Gemeinsam mit dem CTO ist schriftlich festgehalten, welche Entscheidungen bei dir liegen und welche bei ihm

  • 4-6 Monate:

    • Fachbereiche wissen jederzeit, woran gearbeitet wird
    • Monitoring, Alerting und ein Incident-Prozess inklusive Post-Mortems sind etabliert; kritische Security- und DSGVO-Lücken aus der Bestandsaufnahme sind geschlossen
    • Eine erste verlässliche Version unseres Kennzahlen-Reportings zu Leads, Terminen und Aufträgen ist live – mit klar definierten Metriken und benannten Ownern
    • Der CTO wird nur noch bei strategischen Fragen eingebunden, nicht mehr im Tagesgeschäft

  • 7-12 Monate:

    • Die Lieferfähigkeit ist messbar besser als bei deinem Start (z. B. kürzere Durchlaufzeiten, höhere Release-Frequenz, weniger Fehler in Produktion)
    • Ein Plan zum Abbau technischer Schulden läuft und ist mit den Fachbereichen abgestimmt
    • Das Team ist entsprechend der Wachstumsplanung aufgestockt und strukturiert; du hast selbst eingestellt und Verantwortung im Team weiterverteilt
    • Die Plattform trägt das geplante Wachstum ohne Stabilitätsprobleme, und die Datenbasis ist im Unternehmen die anerkannte Wahrheit

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Führung von Tech-Teams (ab ca. 3 Personen) – als Head of Engineering, Engineering Manager, Teamlead, Head of IT oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Einen soliden technischen Hintergrund als Entwicklerin oder Entwickler (idealerweise 5+ Jahre) – du hast selbst gebaut, was du heute verantwortest

  • Verantwortung über mehrere Disziplinen hinweg: Du hast nicht nur Entwicklung geführt, sondern auch mit Daten und/oder Infrastruktur zu tun gehabt

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur (AWS, GCP oder Azure), CI/CD und modernen Web- und Plattform-Architekturen

  • Ein sicheres Gefühl für Priorisierung: Du kannst begründet Nein sagen und hältst auch dann Kurs, wenn mehrere Bereiche gleichzeitig etwas von dir wollen

  • Erfahrung darin, Prozesse einzuführen, die tatsächlich gelebt werden – ohne das Team in Bürokratie zu ersticken

  • Ein datengetriebener Arbeitsstil: Du misst, bevor du entscheidest, und machst Ergebnisse für andere nachvollziehbar

  • Kommunikationsstärke Richtung Nicht-Techniker: Du kannst Sales, Marketing und Geschäftsführung erklären, warum etwas dauert – so, dass es verstanden und akzeptiert wird

  • Eigenverantwortung und Umsetzungsstärke: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, sondern erkennst selbst, was zu tun ist

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Start-up, Scale-up oder Agentur) ist ein klarer Pluspunkt

  • Erfahrung mit Lead-Generierung, Performance Marketing oder B2B-SaaS ist ein Bonus, aber keine Voraussetzung

Was uns wichtig ist

  • Diese Stelle kann zu 100 % im Home Office erledigt werden. Für Team-Events und Quartalsplanung freuen wir uns über ca. 1–2 Präsenztage pro Quartal in unserem Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt (Reisekosten übernehmen wir).

  • Du berichtest direkt an den CTO und bist Teil des erweiterten Führungskreises.

  • Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle in unbefristeter Anstellung.

  • Diese Rolle ist bewusst breit angelegt: Product, Daten, Software und Infrastruktur laufen bei dir zusammen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Die Möglichkeit, die #1 Plattform für planbare Kundengewinnung aufzubauen und mitzugestalten und in einem dynamischen Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld zu arbeiten

  • Ein riesiger Markt, da wir eines der größten Probleme unserer Partner lösen: Wie komme ich laufend an neue Kunden?

  • Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (arbeite je nach Position entweder remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder aus unserem Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt, auch Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist nach Absprache möglich)

  • Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeit (die du mit deinem Team besprichst)

  • 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und jederzeit die Möglichkeit, unbezahlt Urlaub zu nehmen

  • Wir bezuschussen deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead-Rente”)

  • Wir bezuschussen dein Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club und eGym)

  • Ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld (um möglichst produktiv zu sein, arbeiten wir mit modernsten Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum)

  • Für alle Office-Mitarbeiter bieten wir in unserem Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt alles was das Herz begehrt (ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, tollen Kaffee und Espresso, Getränke, Grillabende etc)

  • Für alle Home-Office-Mitarbeitenden beteiligen wir uns mit 20 EUR Home-Office-Pauschale pro Monat

  • Einen Empfehlungsbonus von 1.000 € brutto für jedes neue Teammitglied, dass du uns vorschlägst (nach bestandener Probezeit)

  • Ein ansprechendes Onboarding-Package sowie ein umfassendes Onboarding durch das gesamte Unternehmen

  • Eine interne Academy zur Weiterbildung und als Wissensdatenbank, die du jederzeit von überall aufrufen und nutzen kannst

  • Hunde sind bei uns jederzeit willkommen!

Das sind unsere Werte

  • Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.

  • Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.

  • Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Dein Herz schlägt für visuelles Marketing und du hast Freude daran, wenn deine Kunden mit deiner Hilfe sichtbar besser werden?

Dann unterstütze unsere Mission und mache professionelles Video-Marketing für jeden zugänglich.

Aufgaben

  • Onboarding: Du begleitest neue Kunden (Makler, Immobilienfotografen, Bauträger) von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum ersten begeisternden Video – inklusive Setup, Anbindung und Schulung des Teams.
  • Betreuung & Adoption: Du bist die persönliche Ansprechpartnerin bzw. der persönliche Ansprechpartner Deiner Kunden. Du behältst im Blick, wie aktiv sie unsere Software nutzen, gehst proaktiv auf sie zu und holst stille Accounts zurück ins Boot.
  • Beratung: Du zeigst nicht nur, welche Buttons man klickt, sondern wie ein Video wirklich verkauft – von der Fotoauswahl bis zur Ausspielung auf Instagram, in der Portalanzeige oder im Exposé.
  • Expansion & Renewal: Du erkennst, wann ein Kunde bereit für mehr ist, sicherst Vertragsverlängerungen und entwickelst Accounts weiter (Upselling, weitere Standorte, weitere Nutzer).
  • Produktentwicklung: Du hörst genau hin, was der Markt braucht, und gibst das Feedback der Makler direkt an unser Entwicklerteam weiter.
  • Skalierung: Du baust mit uns die Basis auf, mit der wir viele Kunden gleichzeitig glücklich machen: Hilfe-Artikel, Tutorial-Videos, Webinare und smarte Prozesse.

Qualifikation

  • Service-Mindset: Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern verstehen, was Dein Kunde eigentlich erreichen will – und greifst dafür auch gerne selbst zum Hörer.
  • Digitale Affinität: Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber Du solltest Dich sicher in Web-Apps bewegen und verstehen, warum Video-Content auf Instagram & Co. heute essenziell ist.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst zuhören, zwischen den Zeilen lesen und komplexe Dinge einfach erklären – auch am Telefon mit Menschen, die nicht digital aufgewachsen sind. Dein Deutsch ist exzellent in Wort und Schrift.
  • Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast Du bereits im Customer Success, Account Management, Support oder in der Immobilienbranche gearbeitet. Talentierte Quereinsteiger mit echtem Gespür für Kunden sind aber ebenso willkommen.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du bist top organisiert, zuverlässig und brauchst niemanden, der Dir jeden Tag Deine To-Dos vorgibt. Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Kunden den Überblick.

Benefits

  • Vollzeit oder Teilzeit: Diese Stelle ist auch in Teilzeit möglich (ab 20 Std./Woche). Sag uns einfach in Deiner Bewerbung, welches Modell zu Deinem Leben passt – wir finden gemeinsam eine Lösung.
  • Spannendes Produkt: Du betreust keine trockenen Tabellen, sondern ein visuelles Tool, das Spaß macht und sofort sichtbare Ergebnisse liefert.
  • New Work & Ausstattung: Ob in unserem Büro in Karlsruhe oder im Homeoffice – wir statten Dich komplett aus (Laptop, Headset etc.).
  • Startup-Kultur: Wir sind ein junges Unternehmen ohne Konzern-Politik. Freu Dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, Duz-Kultur und regelmäßige Team-Events.
  • Karrierechancen: Du baust den Bereich Customer Success bei uns mit auf – mit der Perspektive, eigene Strukturen und später ein eigenes Team zu verantworten.

Arbeitsort

Alle bei uns arbeiten einen Teil der Woche von zu Hause. Bis dahin dauert es aber etwas: Wir sind ein kleines Team in Karlsruhe und lernen am schnellsten nebeneinander, deshalb sind die ersten ein bis zwei Monate reine Bürozeit. Danach klären wir mit dir, wie deine Woche aussieht.

Was wir nicht anbieten können, ist eine Stelle, die von Anfang an aus der Ferne läuft. Wohnst du weiter weg und willst trotzdem, dann schreib uns, wie du die erste Zeit lösen würdest.

So bewirbst du dich

Ein Lebenslauf sagt wenig darüber, wie jemand redet und erklärt. Genau darum geht es in dieser Rolle. Deshalb ist der erste Schritt bei uns kein Gespräch über dein Profil, sondern ein kurzes Video von dir. So bekommen wir einen echten Eindruck von dir, und du einen davon, was dich in der Rolle erwartet. Maximal 5 Minuten, zwei Teile:

Zwei Minuten zu dir: wer du bist, was du bisher gemacht hast und warum du zu uns willst. Drei Minuten Praxis: Ein Makler überlegt, ob KI-Videos für seine Objekte taugen, ist aber skeptisch. Erklär ihm, wie marton funktioniert, und nimm ihm seine Bedenken.

Wir erwarten keine Studioqualität. Handy oder Webcam, ein Durchlauf, fertig. Schick uns den Link zu einem Loom-Video oder einem nicht gelisteten YouTube-Video zusammen mit deinem Lebenslauf. Bitte schick uns keine Videodatei im Anhang.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

We are looking for a highly experienced and technically strong Senior Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d) who can take ownership of complex mechanical designs from concept through detailed engineering, manufacturing, assembly, and validation.

We value:

Aufgaben

Du steigst nicht mit der Verantwortung für ein ganzes Kompressorsystem ein. Gemeinsam wählen wir einen Schwerpunkt, der zu deinen Vorkenntnissen passt, und schneiden daraus klare Entwicklungspakete.

Das kann konkret heißen:

  • Technische Fragestellungen bearbeiten: Anforderungen verstehen, Annahmen festhalten, Lösungswege vergleichen und Ergebnisse plausibilisieren.
  • Berechnungen und Parameterstudien durchführen: Kleine Auslegungen oder physikalische Modelle mit Handrechnung, Python oder geeigneten Simulationstools bearbeiten.
  • In CAD mitentwickeln: Bauteile oder Baugruppen modellieren und unter Review fertigungsgerecht verbessern, beispielsweise mit Autodesk Inventor.
  • Versuche vorbereiten und Daten auswerten: Messpläne, Datensätze und Versuchsergebnisse strukturiert bearbeiten und daraus nächste Schritte ableiten.
  • KI als Ingenieurwerkzeug einsetzen: Für Recherche, Berechnung, Code und Dokumentation — mit kritischer Prüfung statt blindem Übernehmen.
  • Nachvollziehbar dokumentieren: Annahmen, Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse so ablegen, dass andere im Team damit weiterarbeiten können.
  • In Werkstatt und Prüfstand dazulernen: Verstehen, wie aus einer Berechnung ein reales Bauteil wird und welche Rückmeldung die Praxis an das Design gibt.

Du wirst dabei von unserem CTO und unserem Prototypenbau-Ingenieur begleitet. Mit wachsender Sicherheit kann auch die Eigenständigkeit deiner Aufgaben wachsen.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst du

  • Du studierst Maschinenbau, Energietechnik, Physik, Mechatronik oder ein vergleichbares technisches Fach.
  • Du verstehst technische und physikalische Grundlagen und willst wissen, warum eine Lösung funktioniert — nicht nur, welches Ergebnis ein Tool ausgibt.
  • Du bringst in mindestens einem Bereich erste praktische Erfahrung mit: CAD/Konstruktion, technische Berechnung/Python oder Versuch/Messdaten. Hochschulprojekte, Formula Student, Praktika, Ausbildung oder eigene Projekte zählen ausdrücklich.
  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und kannst Annahmen, Rechenwege und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar festhalten.
  • Du nimmst Feedback auf, fragst bei Unklarheiten nach und kommunizierst früh, wenn eine Zusage oder Deadline gefährdet ist.
  • Du möchtest KI produktiv einsetzen und bist bereit, ihre Ergebnisse kritisch zu prüfen.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Autodesk Inventor oder einer vergleichbaren CAD-Software.
  • Python sowie Bibliotheken wie NumPy, SymPy, CoolProp oder TesPy.
  • Grundlagen in Thermodynamik, Strömungsmechanik, Festigkeitslehre oder Kältetechnik.
  • Erste Berührung mit Versuchsplanung, Messdatenauswertung oder Systems Engineering.
  • Interesse an Kompressoren, Wärmepumpen, Druckgeräten oder nachhaltiger Energietechnik.

  • Klarer Lernpfad: Wir starten mit einem überschaubaren Entwicklungspaket und erweitern Verantwortung passend zu deinem Fortschritt.
  • AI-First-Arbeitsweise: Du lernst, KI in Recherche, Berechnung, Code und Dokumentation produktiv und verantwortungsvoll einzusetzen.
  • Kurze Wege: In unserem kleinen Team siehst du technische Entscheidungen, Werkstatt und Unternehmensaufbau aus nächster Nähe.
  • Flexibilität mit Verbindlichkeit: Mindestens 15 Stunden pro Woche; Arbeits- und Prüfungsphasen planen wir frühzeitig gemeinsam. Da du an realen Bauteilen, Prüfständen und Versuchen mitarbeitest, findet die Tätigkeit vor Ort in Stuttgart-Süd statt.

description:
Join BIA Hubs as Managing Director (m/f/d)

Some of the most compelling questions in business today — how organizations transform, how leaders grow, how AI reshapes the way people work — are the ones we tackle every day.

We're BIA Hubs, a Berlin-based boutique group and the home of BIA, HelloCircle, and our Startup Hub. A lean team working with fast-paced clients across Europe: GetYourGuide, LiveEO, Novo Nordisk, Roland Berger, the City of Berlin, and a growing ecosystem of scale-ups, multinationals and institutions.

We operate across three business units:

  • BIA – AI and change programs for large organizations
  • HelloCircle – Leadership development for scale-ups and multinationals
  • Startup Hub – Publicly-funded startup programs

Independent and deliberately self-funded, built on product quality and client relationships.

We're looking for an ambitious Managing Director to lead our commercial growth and shape what comes next.

Tasks

This is a senior commercial and leadership role. Externally, you own our growth: new business generation, strategic partnerships, tenders, and market development. Internally, you carry the MD scope: strategy, team leadership, and operational oversight, with clear authority that grows over time.

  • Drive revenue growth and new business: identify, develop, and convert opportunities across our target markets

  • Own our tender and RFP pipeline, from identifying opportunities to delivering the full response
  • Lead senior client relationships and ensure delivery standards across key accounts
  • Think strategy across channels and products, identify growth opportunities and drive them forward
  • Partner with the founder on the decisions that shape the company: positioning, product direction, and organizational strategy
  • Grow and empower the team, supporting their development and leading our internal AI transformation
  • Gradually take on the G&A function: finance, administration, and organizational operations

Requirements

You are a commercially sharp, strategically minded professional with a track record of driving growth in a leading agency or consulting firm.

  • You come from a leading agency, consultancy, or professional services background, with experience building partnerships, developing accounts, and winning business
  • You have strong commercial instincts and a proven ability to identify, develop, and convert strategic opportunities
  • German at native level and English fluency — both are non-negotiable
  • You're analytical, fast-moving, and hands-on
  • You know how to leverage AI tools like Claude to drive real impact
  • You're ambitious and entrepreneurially minded, drawn to the fast-paced dynamics of a 10-person team
  • You bring enthusiasm and energy to your work and are genuinely enjoyable to work with

We value curiosity, commercial drive, and the ambition to build something that lasts. You'll thrive here if you're as energized by a strategic conversation as you are by closing a deal.

Benefits

  • Real MD scope from day one, with room to grow with the company
  • The opportunity to shape and drive our strategic growth
  • A founder who is a genuine thought partner: collaborative, direct, and invested in your success
  • Work on the topics that matter: AI, innovation, and the future of work
  • A diverse, ambitious team with genuine energy and camaraderie

  • Flexible work setup: office in Berlin Mitte combined with home office

We're looking forward to meeting you.

title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
description:
About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.


Contact

Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany

www.uvcpartners.com

UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM.

description:

GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running.

As one of the first fullstack engineers, you'll get to significant impact at GlassFlow.   • Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start.

  • Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked.

  • Genuinely bright and inquisitive: good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured.

  • Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice

  • Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

🚀 What you’ll own:
The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth.
