description:
TL;DR — We're looking for a contract Content Designer who can write both inside the product and across the website. You'll own the words in onboarding, empty states, and error messaging, and partner with PMM and our external design partner on the copy and structure of lovable.dev. This is a full-time engagement.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.

We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured

  • Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result

  • Real web examples. Pages where the copy carries the argument, not just the headline.

  • The ability to look at an already-designed page and say precisely where the message gets lost on a skim, then rewrite it

  • A clear point of view on voice. You can describe a brand's voice and point to copy where you delivered a message in it

  • Comfort working at the pace of a design team that ships daily, in Figma, alongside product designers and PMs rather than downstream of them

  • Comfort partnering with an external design agency as well as internal marketing and design stakeholders

  • Genuine full-time capacity for the length of the contract. We move fast and this needs to be your primary focus

  • Ideally - content strategy chops. Strategy and SEO aren't the core scope here, but the instincts show up in the work

If you're strong on only one side of this, apply anyway. We know we're describing a rare combination. If you're exceptional at in-product writing and have never touched a marketing site, or you're a brilliant web writer who has never written an error message, we still want to see your work. Tell us which side you're great at and we'll take it from there.

What you'll do

In one sentence: Make Lovable sound like one company, in the product and on the website.

  • Own the copy in the moments that decide whether someone sticks: first run in the editor, empty states, failed and partial builds, upgrade and credit prompts

  • Name things - features, surfaces, settings - so the product's own vocabulary holds together

  • Write copy for new and refreshed marketing pages with PMM, making sure current GTM messaging is actually reflected on the site

  • Work with our external design partner on content hierarchy, categorization, and the top-level navigation. You'll shape it with them rather than own it alone

  • Diagnose and fix pages that are already designed but not landing, focusing on hierarchy, scannability, and messages that have to work fast

  • Sit embedded with marketing and design, with full context on how messaging decisions get made across the business

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

  2. Send us two pieces of work: ideally one from inside a product and one from the web, or two from whichever side you're strongest on.

  3. Walk us through your process and craft in a small number of interviews with the marketing and design team.

  4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English - it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join

  • We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal

Ready to join us?

Help us unlock human creativity and build the future of software creation.

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. title: Senior Data Scientist - Business Operations
description:
About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?”

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential.

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale: work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast: ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership: take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

  • 🌎 A culture built for builders: high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.

  • 💰 Share in the success you help create: competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

title: GRC Analyst
description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business. As GRC Analyst, you'll project manage our compliance programme end-to-end, working alongside a Principal Security Engineer who owns the technical security posture.

This is a builder's role. You won't be inheriting a mature, fully-documented programme — you'll be creating and automating the processes, evidence trails and tracking that don't fully exist yet. You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

  • Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

  • Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

  • Coordinate business continuity: BCP/DR obligations and ownership of the Major Incident process, including testing and evidencing

  • Support our AI governance work — our internal AI and engineering AI policies — and help us keep pace with a fast-moving regulatory backdrop (including the EU AI Act), covering data handling, human oversight and vendor assessment

  • Coordinate health & safety compliance as we expand into physical premises and data centre operations, helping build a proper H&S management system where none currently exists

  • Partner closely with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, particularly on KYC, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) evidence, and technical control documentation

  • Help benchmark and align our Code of Conduct and policies with Brookfield's

  • Contribute to the wider roadmap as our footprint grows: precious and conflict-minerals due diligence, export controls, and ESG/energy governance

What You'll Bring

  • Solid UK GDPR and data protection experience

  • Genuine curiosity about how controls actually work — you're not satisfied when "the box is ticked," you want to understand the journey behind it

  • Hyper-organised — you can run multiple concurrent workstreams (audits, questionnaires, training, policy updates) without anything slipping

  • A builder's mindset — comfortable creating and automating a process from nothing, not just following an existing playbook

  • Autonomous and idea-driven — you'll be directed on priorities, not micromanaged on approach

  • Mid-level compliance/GRC/information security experience — your background does not need to be from AI infrastructure, data centres, or a related industry

  • Confident stakeholder management — you'll work directly with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, not just within a compliance team

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycles

  • Exposure to business continuity or major incident processes

  • Familiarity with AI governance or emerging AI regulation

  • Interest in health & safety, environmental/ESG reporting, or physical security and facilities governance

  • Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or equivalent)

Why Join Radiant?

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Real ownership of a function you're building from the ground up, with senior support rather than senior oversight

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry, at the intersection of power, compute and capital

  • Backed by Brookfield — genuine resources, mentorship, and room to grow the role as the company scales

If you're an ambitious accountant who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants to be a core part of building Radiant's financial infrastructure, this is your role.

  • Collaborate across engineering, HR, operations, and marketing teams -translating financial data into insights that inform business decisions and ensuring finance is a true partner in building cohesive company communication.

  • Build and develop the growing Group Reporting team, creating a high-performing function that scales with the business. You'll hire, train, and develop finance professionals, setting the tone for excellence and building a culture where people want to grow their careers.

title: Software Engineer (Data)
description:
Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here.

💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250

🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food!

🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 5 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service!

• Identify accounts where Connect’s consumption-based model opens a new commercial conversation with a new buyer — technical, commercial, and C-suite.

• Create structured handoffs with the Customer Success and Scale teams to ensure expansion signals are acted on, not lost.

• Champion the full OneStatista platform — core, Connect, Statista+, and IQ roadmap — in every strategic account engagement.

Shape the Commercial Operating Model

• Define the KAM coverage model — which accounts receive full KAM attention, at what intensity, and how that changes as the portfolio evolves.

• Partner with the VP Sales EMEA on the FY27 KAM investment case — headcount, tooling, and the team structure required to operate an enterprise motion at scale.

• Represent EMEA KAM in global commercial leadership forums — bringing regional evidence and recommendations to shape global strategy and playbooks.

• Work closely with New Business leadership to ensure the accounts being landed are the right accounts — and that the handoff from new business to KAM is clean.

Your profile

Essential

• Substantial enterprise account management or key account leadership experience — managing strategic relationships at VP, Director, and C-suite level, with deals at £100k+ ACV.

• Evidence of building or materially improving a KAM or enterprise account function — account planning, coverage models, QBR standards, and expansion playbooks.

• Proven track record of protecting GRR and growing NRR in a subscription-based model.

• Commercial instinct for the enterprise motion — value discovery, business case construction, multi-stakeholder navigation, and land-and-expand execution.

• Experience developing and coaching account managers to raise the quality of their commercial conversations — not just their activity levels.

Desirable

• Familiarity with consumption-based or usage-based commercial models.

• Experience working across multiple European markets in a matrixed organisation.

Statista is committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
